g.text: Firmware: set BIASREF_INT = 1 in the same CONFIG3 write that sets PD_BIAS = 1; monitor BIAS_STAT.

g.desc: Firmware: set BIASREF_INT = 1 in the same CONFIG3 write that sets PD_BIAS = 1; monitor BIAS_STAT.

g.text: Do not inject sustained overvoltage or connect a person. RB1/RB2 need pulse- and voltage-rated parts. +5VA backfeed is clamped by Q201 (analog sheet).

g.desc: Do not inject sustained overvoltage or connect a person. RB1/RB2 need pulse- and voltage-rated parts. +5VA backfeed is clamped by Q201 (analog sheet).

g.text: REF is an electrode, not the ADC reference and not GND. It now drives only the U500 follower: channels on REF share no electrode impedance, and the REF electrode carries one leg of leakage instead of up

g.desc: REF is an electrode, not the ADC reference and not GND. It now drives only the U500 follower: channels on REF share no electrode impedance, and the REF electrode carries one leg of leakage instead of up
